_: GENERATED by diagnostics_borouge.py. Each fork is priced by RE-RUNNING the study's own model with one thing moved, never by estimating what it would do.
materiality: 5% of value, the house bar, reused rather than minted here

judgements.name: the beta: a tier-1 own-stock regression against a bottom-up sector beta
judgements.adopted: the own-stock weekly regression against the FTSE ADX General Index, beta 0.4153, cost of capital 6.081%
judgements.alternative: the global Chemical (Diversified) unlevered beta re-levered to this company's own market-value structure, beta 1.0205, cost of capital 8.599%
judgements.direction: the study adopted the higher-value framing
judgements.why: The study names this its own central contested judgement and publishes both the whole way through. The own-stock regression is the beta hierarchy's first choice and it passes the usability gate on all three conditions (n=215 weekly observations, R-squared 0.094 against the 0.05 floor, standard error 0.088 against a beta of 0.415), so it is not discarded. It is also flagged weak by the same machinery — a 90% interval of [0.27, 0.56] spanning 0.70 times the point estimate — and a beta of 0.42 is implausible for a producer whose earnings track a global commodity benchmark. A Dimson lead-lag correction moves it DOWN to 0.351 rather than up, so thin trading does not explain it. This is the single largest fork in the study and the adopted side is the higher-value one.

judgements.name: the risk-free rate: the dollar construction against the dirham one
judgements.adopted: the US 10-year of 4.65% less the United States' own default spread of 0.23% = 4.42%, matching the dollar the company reports, prices and borrows in
judgements.alternative: the UAE dirham government yield of 4.48% less the UAE's own default spread of 0.42% = 4.06%, which the study publishes beside it
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: The study publishes both and adopts the dollar one, reporting the 36 basis point gap under a hard peg rather than reconciling it away. Under a peg the two are competing measurements of one price of time, so the alternative is real; the debt leg stays at its contractual dollar cost on both sides because that is a fact about the facilities rather than a choice. The adopted side is the higher rate and therefore the lower value.

judgements.name: the equity risk premium basis: rating against adjusted-default-spread
judgements.adopted: the published rating-based UAE equity risk premium of 4.87%
judgements.alternative: the mature-market premium of 4.23% plus the UAE adjusted default spread of 0.42% = 4.65%
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: Both bases are published in the study's own cost-of-capital table and the same basis is stripped from the risk-free rate as is added back, so country risk enters exactly once either way. The adopted basis is the higher premium and therefore the lower value.

judgements.name: the cost of debt: the marginal margin over the long dollar rate against overnight
judgements.adopted: the arm's-length margin of 0.900% over the 10-year dollar rate = 5.55%, tenor-matched to a perpetual cash flow stream
judgements.alternative: the same margin over the overnight rate the facilities actually float on = 4.55%
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: The facilities are floating over overnight secured financing, so the observed rate today is the overnight one; the study carries the same margin over the long rate because the cash flows being discounted are perpetual and a discount rate must be tenor-matched. Both are defensible readings of the same disclosed margin, and the adopted one is the higher rate and therefore the lower value.

judgements.name: the cost of debt: arm's-length against the rate actually being paid
judgements.alternative: the weighted related-party margin the two facilities actually carry, 0.874%
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: Two prices exist for the same borrower because the facilities are related-party. The study uses the arm's-length one on the ground that a marginal cost of capital should not embed a shareholder subsidy, and the difference is 3 basis points, so nothing in the answer turns on it.

judgements.name: lease liabilities: deducted in the bridge, excluded from the capital weights
judgements.adopted: leases outside the weights, equity weight 85.45%
judgements.alternative: leases inside the weights as debt, equity weight 84.61%
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: A lease treated as debt in the bridge and not in the weights is an inconsistency an outside critique raised and the study accepted as immaterial WITH THE NUMBER ATTACHED, which is what this row is. It is recorded because "immaterial" is a claim and it is priced here rather than asserted.

judgements.name: the crux: how long navigation through the Strait of Hormuz stays impaired
judgements.adopted: published BOTH ways and never averaged — a normalisation branch and a prolonged branch, each with the condition it holds under
judgements.alternative: one branch chosen and published as the single central
judgements.direction: the study adopted the higher-value framing
judgements.why: The judgement is binary and about the world rather than about the model, so an average would describe a shipping lane that is neither open nor closed; the study takes no side and shows the reader the question. THE DIRECTION THIS ROW CONTRIBUTES IS AN ARTEFACT OF THE ANCHOR AND NOT A FACT ABOUT THE STUDY: this record is anchored on the normalisation branch because that is the branch the study's own lens record names as its primary value, and anchoring on the other branch would reverse this row's sign. The sign test is therefore reported on both anchors and neither is near the flag.

judgements.name: sales above production: the disclosed sourcing channel kept or discarded
judgements.adopted: sales run at 1.0296 times production, the audited three-year mean, held flat and not grown
judgements.alternative: sales capped at capacity times utilisation, so the company sells only what it makes
judgements.direction: the study adopted the higher-value framing
judgements.why: Borouge sells more tonnes than it produces because it sources product from its parent, from its own compounding plant and from other partners — 54 kt of second-quarter 2026 sales alone. Capping sales at production discards a channel the company discloses, and because the cap runs into the terminal year it compounds. The uplift is measured from the audited record rather than assumed, and the adopted side is the higher-value one.

judgements.name: the terminal return on capital: 12% against the cost of capital itself
judgements.adopted: 12% in perpetuity, above the 6.08% cost of capital, so reinvestment creates value for ever
judgements.alternative: a terminal return equal to the cost of capital, so growth is value-neutral and the reinvestment it requires earns exactly what it costs
judgements.direction: the study adopted the higher-value framing
judgements.why: The terminal charge is built on the reinvestment identity, so the return on capital sets what fraction of terminal profit is retained: at 12% it is 16.7% and at the cost of capital it is 32.9%. Two outside critiques challenged the 12% as aggressive for a commodity producer in perpetuity, and the study's ground is that this company earned high-teens returns across the three audited years on an advantaged feedstock position. Both are defensible and the adopted one is the higher-value framing.

judgements.name: the other-production-cost split: re-anchored to the audited year or left as fitted
judgements.adopted: the fixed leg re-anchored to $790m so the cost line reproduces the AUDITED FY2025 figure at FY2025's own production volume
judgements.alternative: the fixed leg of $663m the three-year least-squares fit returns on its own
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: A three-point regression cannot identify this split — production spans only 161 kt across the three audited years — so the fit was calibrated on sales tonnes while the forecast drives it on production tonnes, and it understated the audited FY2025 cost by $127m at that year's own production. Re-anchoring ties the level to the accounts and leaves the variable rate as a disclosed judgement rather than a fit. The adopted side charges more cost and is therefore the lower-value framing.

judgements.name: the Borouge 4 operator fee: terminated at recontribution or capitalised for ever
judgements.adopted: no perpetuity — the fee runs only until the assets are acquired, which the sponsors say is not anticipated before 2029, and the listed company's share afterwards is zero
judgements.alternative: the same fee capitalised to a perpetuity, as an earlier edition of this study did
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: The agreement the fee comes from terminates on its own cited disclosure, and the study's own text says the listed company owns no part of the expansion afterwards. Capitalising a stream past the date its own disclosure ends it was the largest single downward correction any critique of this study produced. The explicit ramp is kept at its full present value of $290m; only the perpetuity is refused, and the adopted side is the lower-value framing.

judgements.name: the effective tax rate: the audited three-year mean or the reviewed half
judgements.adopted: the mean of the three audited years, 28.74%
judgements.alternative: the rate the reviewed first half of 2026 actually shows, 25.10%
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: A near-term reviewed actual outranks a stale full-year rate on this house's own standing rule, and this is the one place in the study where the rule points the other way from what was done: the three audited years run 28.57% / 29.01% / 28.62% and the reviewed half runs 25.10%, so the mean is the more stable estimate of a rate that has barely moved while the half is the more recent observation of it. Carrying the mean is defensible; it is also the lower-value framing, and the half was not disclosed in the delivered edition, which an outside critique raised.

judgements.name: the realisation residual: the audited three-year mean or the reviewed half
judgements.adopted: the three audited years, 1.0676 on polyethylene and 1.0321 on polypropylene
judgements.alternative: the reviewed first half of 2026, 1.0947 and 1.0186
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: The residual is the gap between revenue per tonne actually filed and the published benchmark-plus-premium construct, computed rather than assumed. The half-year runs above the audited mean on polyethylene and below it on polypropylene, so the two legs pull opposite ways and the net is small; the study carries the audited mean because a single disrupted half is a poor estimate of a structural residual.

judgements.name: maintenance capital expenditure: the steady-state figure or the audited record
judgements.alternative: the audited three-year mean of $224.8m, which is what the company actually spent
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: The three audited years ran $199m, $167m and $308m and the study carries $320m, which exceeds all three. An outside critique made exactly that point and the study accepted it as a real but small overcharge; it is the lower-value framing and it is recorded here rather than remembered.

judgements.name: the steady-state premium: management's guidance or the audited realised record
judgements.adopted: the company's own through-the-cycle guidance, $200 a tonne on polyethylene and $140 on polypropylene
judgements.alternative: the premium the company actually realised across the three audited years, $212.0 and $136.3
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: A driver that takes management's forward target as an input inherits whatever lean that target carries, so the guidance is a thing to score rather than to consume. The audited realised record runs $215 / $197 / $224 on polyethylene against guidance of $200, and $125 / $150 / $134 on polypropylene against $140, so the two legs disagree in opposite directions and the guidance is not uniformly the flattering side. It is here because it is a fork the study resolved, not because the number moves.

judgements.name: terminal growth: 2.0% nominal against the study's own UAE inflation of 2.1%
judgements.adopted: 2.0% nominal in dollars for a producer whose owned capacity is fixed
judgements.alternative: the 2.1% domestic inflation the same model escalates its own fixed costs at, which is zero real growth rather than a 0.1% real decline
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: A growth rate is honest when it is stored as a real rate on a stated inflation path rather than typed as a nominal. 2.0% against the 2.1% this model escalates its own fixed cost, general and administrative expense and labour at is a real decline of about 0.10% a year in perpetuity — small, and nothing in the filings states it. The adopted side is the lower-value framing. The gap is 10 basis points because the peg makes this the flattest terminal in the book, not because the question is unimportant.

judgements.name: the Borouge 4 fee level: the accretion disclosure or the cumulative one
judgements.adopted: the lower of the two, $120.8m a year, from the "approximately 10% annual earnings accretion" disclosure
judgements.alternative: the higher, $400.0m a year, from the "$400m of cumulative net profit over three years" disclosure read against this study's own ramp
judgements.direction: the study adopted the lower-value framing
judgements.why: The sponsors quantify the same fee two ways in the same announcement and the two do not agree — they differ by 3.3 times — so the study computes both, carries the lower and discloses the gap rather than picking the one that reads better. The stream is 1.2% of enterprise value either way. The adopted side is the lower-value framing.

judgements.name: the payable period: the full operating payable or trade payables alone
judgements.adopted: trade payables plus accruals plus amounts due to related parties, 92.5 days
judgements.direction: the study adopted the higher-value framing
judgements.why: The feedstock account with the parent is where most of this company's supplier credit actually sits, so excluding it reports a payable period of 36 days for a business that buys its ethane on a group account. The adopted side shortens the cash cycle and is the higher-value framing, and it is worth 0.07% because working capital moves the level of the balance once and not the cash flow for ever.

flagged_means: FLAGGED IS NOT FAILED — a company can deserve a consistent read, and failing on one would push studies to resolve forks inconsistently to stay green. What a study may not do is go unmeasured.
